days.title: Monastic Heritage and Visitor Center
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Glendalough Visitor Center
stops.detail: The Glendalough Visitor Center offers visitors extensive information on the history of the monastery.

stops.name: Klostersiedlung
stops.detail: It is known for its monastic settlement – one of the most famous on the island of Ireland – at the lower of the two lakes.

stops.name: St. Kevin’s Church
stops.detail: The compact 11th-century chapel St. Kevin’s Church was also given the name St. Kevin’s Kitchen because of the tower resembling a chimney.

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: St. Kevin’s Cross
stops.detail: A Celtic cross, St. Kevin’s Cross, can also be visited.

stops.name: Überreste eines Bergbaubetriebes
stops.detail: Near the shore of the second lake are several other building remains from the founding period of the monastery as well as the remains of a mining operation.

stops.name: Wanderwege
stops.detail: In addition to the historical sights, there are several well-signposted hiking trails.
